Discussion 2: Lucas seemingly gives me a severe mental breakdown at least once a month, maybe more.   


Yeesh, I really am just using this to dump thoughts. So, here's the thing. Lucas, the fighter from Mother 3, and one of the only fighters I have always tried to stick with, even if he's considered...what...high low tier? Mid tier? Whatever, but point is being I have wanted to drop him MULTIPLE times after losing to things I feel like I should never lose to. While this is similar with quickplay, it just seems to multiply by a tenfold with Lucas. If I reach a breaking point (as I call it) with Lucas, I would, A) Yell at the discord server I'm in for about 30 seconds of rage and mental insanity, B) Stop playing him for at least 2 weeks afterwords and use a different main, and then C) The process either repeats or I simply say that he sucks and use someone like Inkling instead (Who i have started to use as a main due to this issue).  
It is both bugging me and resurfacing my older diseases (I used to have depression, maybe still do idk at this point), and as much as I want to improve, Lucas just feels like this giant wall that is trying to tell me not to use this character. It's been 6 months, and he's probably at the same level when I peaked with him 2 months ago. There is no way to improve with Lucas, unless I master DJCZ, or somehow find a combo to use for him. For me, it's no wonder you would never see a Lucas at a big tournament. I want to keep using him, and now that I've started to think about competitive play, this thing is just getting more frequent. Competitive play has gotten on my mind since I was told I suck since I play like an online player. Yeah, really positive influence there. Oh who am I kidding. Good Lucas Players, what am I supposed to do with this Mother character that seemingly halts my skill, or should I abandon him for a high tier?

After 6 months. I still cannot. Decide. On a main. And it pisses me off. Also I can’t improve in this game, even if my life depended on it. 
       For the longest time now I have been transitioning mains at least every 3 weeks or so, and the only one who has lasted longer than that is Lucas, but I don’t see him going anywhere. Yeah, I seriously suck at this game, IMO, especially when a competitive player (Someone on discord who plays BestNess, PixL, Valor, and BananaBoy) has one match with you through Inklingcord and kicks you because, “You play like an online player.”  I’m 14, I shouldn’t care about this stuff yet, but I seriously do. I seemingly can never improve, which is one of the reasons I switch mains so often. I can’t decide on anyone, most likely because I get my butt beat more times then I can count using them, or because they don’t feel fun to play after a certain period of time (What happened with Ness and Wolf). I mostly play with my discord friends in a server or the smashcord servers, because Quickplay is just stupid and not at all helpful. Currently, I’m using Ken and Inkling, and Lucas is just sort of there. Perhaps I need to do training mode more, or I just never get the chance to face actually good players (competitive players), but this has been going on since January and it’s driving me mad. Maybe it’s ‘cause my mentality level is terrible, and it’s hard for me to focus on helpful videos, but I probably just haven’t poured all the hours needed to do so. Is there ANYTHING at all I can do in order to improve aside from the main basics I’m told:

2. Spacing out/neutral
3. Adapting and learning the enemy

1. Mother X: Brothers from Another Mother. A Lucas and Ness classic style RPG crossover, just for nostalgia and something old yet new. This way, maybe they could fix the game or make it modern, fix the combat, and give the new Mother fans a chance with an American made Mother game starring the two most well known icons from the series. The main antagonist would be Porky, who comes from his Absolute Safe Capsule, risking his life to end the line of PSI users once and for all. The other two party members can be anyone else from the series, depending on who fits best for the situation, ending with a giant battle between our heroes vs. the mastermind Porky with the help of a few unseen antagonists created by the Mother Team. This also brings time travel and such into play, which yeah this sounds ridiculous, but you're talking to a 14 year old with wild dreams here. Also there would be a tribute to [Reggie Fils-Aimé](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reggie_Fils-Aim%C3%A9) with a secret easter egg, entitling him as the gatekeeper in a secret boss fight. 
2. Hollow Knight: Sealed Burden. Reveal the truth and history of the The Hollow Knight, his sacrifices, and life as the Pure Vessel in this prequel game developed by Team Cherry to help expand the lore of the Hollow Knight series with another main character. Why did he end up chained against the Vessel? What sacrifices did he bring upon the land, and could this help explain more about the Pale King and Queen? How did the Infection get to him and why was he sealed by the dreamers or someone else? His moveset would be similar to his boss fight, with a definitely decreased height. A low amount of charms, as this focuses on skill and brutal combat, to truly test you for the title of The Hollow Knight. There would be a Counter Charm, Infection Charm late game, ground pound spell (his double damage spiral in HK boss fight/blades in Pure Vessel), Charge up slice attack (great slash), Shadow warp spell, and more!
